mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is a clause in the preliminary provisions.
The best place is a clause in the preliminary provisions.
Fill in the blank: ______ is used in the defined term; the definition uses a noun.
A verb is used in the defined term; the definition uses a noun.
Fill in the blank: ______ are used today rather less than in the past; many drafters consider them to be redundant.
Preambles are used today rather less than in the past; many drafters consider them to be redundant.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a statutory provision designed to help users find their way around legislation.
A road map clause is a statutory provision designed to help users find their way around legislation.
fib: ______ is an essential feature of any Bill being drafted for introduction into the Legislature.
Long titles A long title is an essential feature of any Bill being drafted for introduction into the Legislature.
______ is a preliminary statement that explains why legislation is needed, in contrast with the long title which states the main legal changes the Bill is to make to fill that need.
A preamble is a preliminary statement that explains why legislation is needed, in contrast with the long title which states the main legal changes the Bill is to make to fill that need.
______ are the Companies and Allied Matters Act and Income Tax Acts.
Examples are the Companies and Allied Matters Act and Income Tax Acts.
